title: MRiscX
abstract: A Hoare logic for verifying unstructured RISC-V-like assembly in Lean, following Lundberg et al. (SEFM 2020), with a certified interpreter, proved structural Hoare rules, per-instruction specifications, custom elaborators and tactics, and a complete One-Time-Pad correctness proof.

informal.hoareTripleUp: Defines the MRiscX Hoare triple, asserting that from any state satisfying the precondition the code reaches a successor state satisfying the postcondition while respecting the line whitelist and blacklist.
informal.S_SEQ: Proves the sequencing Hoare rule, peeling off the last instruction of a code block.
informal.PRE_STR: Proves the precondition-strengthening rule for MRiscX Hoare triples.
informal.POST_WEAK: Proves the postcondition-weakening rule for MRiscX Hoare triples.
informal.specification_LoadImmediate: Proves the per-instruction Hoare specification of the load-immediate instruction.
informal.proof_otp: Proves the full correctness of a One-Time-Pad implementation written in MRiscX assembly.
